text.tspan: corpus_first: any rows above the distance threshold
distance (default): best hit's vector distance <= weak_distance
cross_encoder: best of the top 5 >= weak_threshold
either: weak when one of the two says so
weak chunks dropped (kept in the log for hit@k),
notice appended to the tool result
No source answered: final turn without tools,

div.h2: Measured per pool, not in one average

ul.li: in-corpus: faithfulness / relevance / completeness, hit@k / MRR
answered from a tool: remote_grounding (grounded in what the tool said, not in truth)
off-domain: off_domain_grounding, refusals, answers with no support
outcome histogram: answered / refused / unsupported / narrated call / exhausted

text.tspan: admissible? does the question itself carry
corpus_first: admitted tools stay out of the schema
until the corpus fails, dispatch refuses them by name
